description: Implementation library entries for 180nm processes (requirements §3.8). Densities are bound to a concrete implementation, not to the node. Every value is empirical until FR-EST-13 calibration replaces it. GF180MCU entries carry calibrated values from the eda-gf180 plugin (M1.5); re-run calibration after changing the tool image.
